chapter: Bird, Coltrane and Dinah Washington recollections
title: The narcotics hospital in Lexington
summary: Brower and Cobb discuss Lexington, where players checked themselves in to clean out.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Did Lex have that reputation? Because a lot of cats went through there, and the Tombs too.
What, Lex Humphries? What Lex you talking about?

Oh yeah. All them guys went through it. I think they thought it was cleansing their bodies so they could get higher quicker or something like that. I don’t know what they did. They have a vacation or something there.
“I just go down to Lex” blah blah “and come on back.” A lot of them did that.
Could – you could check yourself in.
You could check yourself in. You could check yourself out. If they sent you there, they owned you.

So that’s what a lot of guys did. They’d go down there and check their self in, because it was a weaning-off process, I think, that probably happened, that they was getting treated every day for what they needed, without having to be on the street, doing what they had to do for it. By the time they do it, then they come back on the street clean, it’s easier to save them out – make some – I don’t know what their theory was, but it was something like that. They would check their self in like it was a country club.
